params.caption: 🕹️ 21 more original Xbox games are now playable on PC Announced at Xbox FanFest, 21 original Xbox titles joined the PC backward compatibility catalogue, bringing the total to 25. The list includes TimeSplitters 2 and TimeSplitters: Future Perfect (never ported to PC before), Morrowind, Star Wars Battlefront 1 & 2, KOTOR 1 & 2 and Red Faction 2. Four games, including both KOTORs, support achievements. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 01:01 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: VGC · GamesRadar+ 👥 @Xbox 🔥 React if TimeSplitters 2 is coming home · 💬 Which classic are you booting first? #Xbox #TimeSplitters #PCGaming #GamingNews
